description: Contextual message with a semantic tone, content and optional actions.

howToUse: Use it for a message about the page or the section it sits in: a limit about to end, a change of rules, a tip.
Choose the `tone` by meaning, write a short `title`, and say what to do in the text.
Put the action in `action` ("Upgrade plan"). Use `dismissible` only when the message can really be ignored.
alternatives: A short result after an action ("Saved"): Toast or Snackbar.
A decision people must take before going on: AlertDialog.
The error of one field: the `error` of the field.

keyboard.action: Moves to the action and to the close button, when there are.
Runs the action in focus, or closes the message.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon on the left (the DS bundles no icons; pass one by prop).

props.name: action
props.description: Optional action on the right (e.g. `<Button size="sm">Upgrade</Button>`).

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Shows the close button. The banner leaves with a transition and unmounts.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called after the banner leaves (end of the transition).

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the close button (default: "Dismiss notice", in the active language).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.

examples.label: Info (first-run hint)
Note (explanatory note)
Warn (limit close)
Danger (persistent failure)
Upsell (plan lock banner)
Dismissible
examples.description: Closes with a transition (motion token) and unmounts; `onDismiss` notifies the app.
